caption: The drawing shows a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a stylized, golden-yellow bird with widespread wings, surrounded by flame-like shapes that emanate outward in varying directions from its lower and rear parts. The flames have a gradient of yellow to light brown coloring, giving a sense of depth and texture. The bird’s body is set within the middle of the flames, with its wings stretched wide and upright, and the tail feathers merging into the fiery base. The composition is symmetrical with the bird and flames occupying the central focus, leaving ample negative space around them.
title: Ornamental Wood Carving: Eagle
